title: LLMs in Cloud: A Discussion on Architecture, Orchestration, and Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.33475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learning toward distributed, memory-intensive generative workloads. However, serving massive foundation models under stringent Service Level Objectives (SLO) exposes critical physical and system bottlenecks. These challenges include the persistent High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) wall, operational asymmetry between compute-bound prefilling and memory-bandwidth-bound decoding, explosive Key-Value (KV) cache expansion, prohibitive serverless cold starts, and hardware reliability vulnerabilities. Existing literature reviews remain layer-siloed, decoupling low-level accelerator virtualization from cluster orchestration and runtime inference, while largely overlooking defining advancements from 2024 to 2026. translated_title: 云端大语言模型：关于架构、编排与推理的探讨
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在云数据中心的广泛部署，标志着从无状态深度学习向分布式、内存密集型生成式工作负载的根本性范式转变。然而，在严格的服务级别目标（SLO）下服务大规模基础模型暴露出关键的物理与系统瓶颈。这些挑战包括持续存在的高带宽内存（HBM）墙、计算受限的预填充阶段与内存带宽受限的解码阶段之间的运行不对称性、键值（KV）缓存的爆炸式增长、代价高昂的无服务器冷启动，以及硬件可靠性方面的脆弱性。现有的文献综述仍然局限于分层孤立的视角，将底层加速器虚拟化与集群编排和运行时推理相割裂，并且在很大程度上忽视了2024年至2026年间的里程碑式进展。为了解决这些局限性，本研究提出了一个全面的、跨层次的系统性综述……
tldr: 该论文以跨层次的系统性视角综述了云端大语言模型服务在架构、编排与推理层面的关键瓶颈——包括HBM内存墙、预填充与解码的不对称性、KV缓存膨胀及无服务器冷启动等，并梳理了2024至2026年间的前沿进展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive cross-layer systematic review of the architecture, orchestration, and inference challenges in serving LLMs on the cloud—including the HBM wall, prefill-decode asymmetry, KV cache expansion, and serverless cold starts—while highlighting defining advancements from 2024 to 2026.
